sentences.text: IPMA lists 17 active weather warnings in 25 areas of Portugal, 6 orange and 11 yellow.
Orange or red warnings for rough sea are active in Aveiro, Braga, Coimbra, Leiria, Porto and Viana do Castelo.
The IPMA sea forecast for the Porto coast on 2026-11-20 gives waves of 2.4 to 4.5 metres from NW and sea temperatures of 16.6 to 16.7 °C.
Porto has a 100% chance of rain today, 2026-11-19, with a minimum of 12.5 °C and a maximum of 16.6 °C.
Coimbra has an 84% chance of rain today, with a minimum of 11.3 °C and a maximum of 17.4 °C.
Lisboa has a 0% chance of rain today, with a minimum of 12.8 °C and a maximum of 18.4 °C.
Fire risk is low today in all 278 of Portugal's municipalities.
